spans.s:
m. (-कः)
Epidemic or pestilential disease.
E.
मृ to die, वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Epidemic disease, plague.
2 A falcon, a hawk.
3 A slayer, a destroyer.
E.
मृ to die, causal form, aff. वुन्.

m. (-तः)
An emerald.
E.
मरक epidemic disease, तॄ to cross or escape, aff. ड; it is also read मरकतक n. (-कं).

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Emerald, of the colour of an emerald, &c.
E.
मरकत, and अण् aff.

n. (-क्तं)
An emerald.

n. (-णं)
Death, dying.
E.
मृ to die, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
मृ to die, causal form, to kill, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-तः)
Death, dying.
E.
मृ to die, अतच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्दः)
The nectar or honey of a flower.
E.
मकरन्द, q. v. the second syllable being rejected; also with कन् added मरन्दक.

n. (-कः)
A flower.
E.
मरन्द nectar or honey, ओकस् abode.

f. (-ली)
A plant, commonly Bichati.

m. (-रः)
A granary, a place where grain, &c. is kept.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Soft, mild, bland.
m. (-लः)
1 A sort of goose with red legs and bill, or perhaps the

Flamingo.
2

Lampblack, used as a collyrium.
3 A duck.
4 A horse.
5 A cloud.
6 A grove or garden of pomegranate trees.
7 A rogue, a scoundrel.
E.
मृ to die, aff. आलच्.

n. (-चं)
Pepper.
E.
मृ to die, (venom,) and इच aff.; considered as an antidote; also मरीच.

n. (-चं)
Pepper, (Piper nigrum.)
E.
मृ to die, ईच aff.

m. (-चः)
1 The name of a Rākṣasa, the companion of RĀVAṆ

A military or royal elephant.
3 A sort of berry, commonly Kakkoli.
f. (-ची)
A goddess, peculiar to the Bauddhas.
E.
मरीच a saint, &c., aff. अण्.

m. (-मा)
Death, dying.
E.
मृ to die, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-चिः)
1 A saint, the son of BRAHMĀ, and one of the Prajāpatis, and Brahmādikas, or first created beings, and sovereigns of the world.
2 A niggard, a miser.
mf. (-चिः)
A ray of light.
E.
मृ to perish, (darkness,) Uṇādi aff. ईचि.

f. (-का)
The Mirage; vapor which in hot, and sandy countries especially appears at a distance like a sheet of water.
E.
मरीचि a ray of light, कन् aff., implying resemblance.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Peppered, seasoned with pepper.
E.
मरिच pepper, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Splendid, radiant.
m. (-ली)
The sun.
E.
मरीचि, and मालिन् having a chaplet.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Who or what cleans or rubs repeatedly.
E.
मृज to rub, reiter. v., अच् aff.

m. (-रुः)
1 A region or soil destitute of water, sands, a desert.
2 A mountain.
3 The province Marwar, or, in the plu. (-रुवः) The inhabitants.
E.
मृ to die, (where,) and Uṇādi aff. उ.

m. (-जः)
A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi.
E.
मरु a desert, and ज produced.

f. (-टा)
A woman with a high forehead.
E.
मृ to perish, (of love for such a woman,) उटच् aff.

f. (-ण्डा)
A woman with a high forehead.
E.
मृ to die, उण्डच् aff.: see the last.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A serpent's egg.
2 A road.
3 A place spread with cow-dung; some authorities have मारण्ड.

m. (-रुत्)
1 Wind, air, or its deified personification.
2 A deity, an immortal.
n. (-रुत्)
A sort of perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla.
f. (-रुत्)
A kind of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.)
E.
मृ to die, Uṇādi aff. उति.

m. (-तः)
1 Air, wind.
2 A deity.
3 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpātali.
E.
अच् added to the preceding.

m. (-त्तः)
1 Wind, a gale.
2 The name of a king.
E.
मरुत्, and तप् added.

m. (-तः)
1 Air, wind.
2 Vital air, one of the three humours of the body.
3 A wind, a demigod, of whom there is a class consisting of forty-nine.
n. (-तं)
Burnt-offering on conception.
E.
मृ to die, (by excess of it,) उति aff., and the vowel made long; the demigods, called Mārutas, are said to be the sons of Diti, formed of the divisions of the foetus in utero, by the Vajra, or thunderbolt of INDRA, and to be named from that deity's addressing the foetus he thus divided by मारोदीः weep not.

m. (-रः)
A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.)
E.
मरुत् wind, (eructation,) and कर making.

m. (-थः)
The atmosphere, sky, heaven.
E.
मरुत् the wind, and पथ road.

m. (-लः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
मरुत् the wind, and पाल who nourishes.

m. (-त्त्रः)
BHĪMASENA, the second of the PĀṆḌU princes.
E.
मरुत् the deity of the wind, and पुत्त्र son.

m. (-वः)
A lion.
E.
मरुत् wind, and प्लव who leaps.

n. (-लं)
Hail.
E.
मरुत् wind, and फल fruit.

m. (-त्वान्)
1 A name of

INDRA.
2
The monkey

Hanumān.
3

A cloud.
E.
मरुत् wind, मतुप् aff.

m. (-खः)
INDRA.
E.
मरुत् the wind, (the deity,) and सखि friend, aff. टच्.

m. (-लः)
A sort of fan made of deer's or buffalo's skin.
E.
मरुत् wind, आन्दोल agitating.

n. (-जं)
Flocculent seeds wafted by the wind.
E.
मरुत् wind, ध्वज standard.

m. (-द्धः)
1 VIṢṆ

A sort of vessel used in sacrifices.
3 A portion of the Sāma Veda.
E.
मरुत् the wind, बद्ध bound.

m. (-थः)
1 A horse.
2 A car in which idols are carried.
E.
मरुत् the wind, and रथ a vehicle.

m. (-मः)
A fœtid mimosa.
E.
मरु dry, and द्रुम a tree.

n. (-र्त्म)
The atmosphere, heaven, sky.
E.
मरुत् the wind, and वर्त्मन् road or path.

Smoke.
2

Fire.
E.
मरुत् wind, and वाह vehicle.

m. (-पः)
A camel.
E.
मरु the desert, and द्विप the elephant.

f. (-ता)
The Kāverī river in the peninsula.
E.
मरुत् the wind, and वृत covered, screened.

f. (-ला)
1 A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.)
2 Another plant, commonly Belśunṭh.
E.
मरुत् a deity, and माला a garland.

m. (-यः)
A camel.
E.
मरु a sandy soil, and प्रिय fond of; it also occurs मरुत्प्रिय m. (-यः) from मरुत् wind.

m. (-भूः)
The province of Marwar, or plu. (-भुवः) The inhabitants of Marwar.
E.
मरु sandy, and भू country.

m. (-लः)
A sort of duck.
E.
मॄ to die, उलच् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A large thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.)
2 A species of basil (Ocymum), described as having small leaves and red flowers.
3 A variety of the citron or lime, said to be a thorny plant, and to bear a small fruit.
4 A flower, (Artemisia vulgaris.)
5 A tiger.
6 The ascending node.
7 A crane.
E.
मरु a sandy or dry soil, वा to grow or go, aff. क, and कन् added; it sometimes occurs, मरूवक.

nf. (-लं-ली)
A desart, a dry and desart tract.
E.
मरु, and स्थल place.

m. (-कः)
A sort of deer.
E.
मृ to die, ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-वा)
1 A cucumber.
2 Wild cotton.
3 A small species of the fœtid mimosa.
4 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
मरु dry soil, and उद्भव produced.

m. (-लिः)
The Makara, a marine monster, apparently the Monodon or unicorn, and usually confounded with the crocodile or shark.
E.
मृ to die, (by it,) ओलिच् aff.; also with कन् added मरोलिक m. (-कः)

m. (-र्कः)
1 The air, the wind.
2 The body.
3 A monkey.
E.
मर्च to sound, or a Sautra root, to move, Uṇādi aff. कन्.

m. (-कः)
A spider.
E.
मर्क going, aff. कन्.

m. (-टः)
1 A monkey or ape.
2 A spider.
3 The large crane, called in India the adjutant, (Ardea argala.)
4 A kind of venom.
f. (-टी)
1 A variety of grey Bonduc, (Guilandina bonduccella.)
2 Cowatch, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
3 A small or female monkey.
E.
मर्क a Sautra root, to go, Uṇādi aff. अटन्.

m. (-कः)
1 A spider.
2 An ape.
3 A fruit.
4 A demon.
5 A fish.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-ली)
A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
E.
मर्कट an ape, and पिप्पली long pepper.

m. (-यः)
A tree, a kind of Mimosa, (M. kauki.)
E.
मर्कट a monkey, and प्रिय beloved.

m. (-सः)
A spider's web, a cobweb.
E.
मर्कट a spider, and वास abode; also with कन् added मर्कटवासक.

n. (-स्यं)
Copper.
E.
मर्कट a monkey, and आस्य face.

m. (-न्दुः)
A sort of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon.)

f. (-रा)
1 A cave, a hole, a chasm.
2 A vessel.
3 A barren or childless woman.

r. 4th and 10th cls. (मर्चति मर्चयति)
1 To sound.
2 To go.

f. (-र्ज्जूः)
Cleaning, cleansing, purification.
m. (-र्ज्जूः)
1 A washerman.
2 A catamite.
E.
मृज to cleanse, aff. ऊ.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A man, a mortal.
E.
मृ to die, तन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Mortal, what must or should die.
E.
मृ to die, तव्य aff.

m. (-र्त्त्यः)
1 A man, a mortal.
2 The earth, the world, the habitation of mortals.
f. (-र्त्त्या)
A woman, a female.
E.
मर्त्त as above, यत् pleonasm.

m. (-खः)
A demigod, attendant on KUVERA, a Kinnara, a Yakṣa.
E.
मर्त्त्य a mortal, and मुख chief, principal.

n. (-नं)
1 Rubbing, touching.
2 Rubbing, grinding, pounding, &c.
E.
मृद to rub or grind, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be rubbed or touched.
E.
मृद to rub, अनीयर aff.

ind.
Having rubbed or touched.
E.
मृद to rub, क्त्वा aff.

m. (-लः)
A sort of drum.
E.
मृद to rub or strike, aff. अच्; मर्द्द striking, and ला to get, aff. क.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Strung, tied.
2 Rubbed, ground, pounded.
3 Obtained, got.
E.
मृद to rub, aff. क्त.

r. 1st cl. (मर्बति)
To go, to move.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A learned and intelligent man or Brahman.
E.
मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 A joint, an articulation of the body.
2 A vital member or organ.
3 Secret meaning or purpose, a secret, any thing hidden or recondite.
E.
मृ to die, aff. मनिन्.

Fatal.
2

Penetrating, piercing.
3 Painful.
E.
मर्म्म, and भेदिन् what cuts or breaks.

m. (-रः)
The rustling sound of cloth or dry leaves.
f. (-री)
A sort of pine, (P. Devadaru.)
E.
मृ to die, अरन् aff., and मुक् augment.

m. (-कः)
A pauper, a low or humble man.
E.
मृ to die, (with distress,) Uṇādi aff. ईकन्, and the root reduplicate.

m. (-विट् or -वित्)
A learned and intelligent man or Brahman.
E.
मर्म्म secret meaning (of the Śāstras), and विट् who knows.

m. (-दी)
An acute and intelligent man.
E.
मर्म्म secret, and वेदिन् who knows: see the last.

mfn. (-स्पृक्)
Sharp, corrosive, giving pain.
E.
मर्म्म a joint, and स्पृश् what touches.

mfn. (-विद् or -वित्)
Piercing or affecting the joints, (pain, &c.)
E.
मर्म्म a joint, व्यध to pierce or pain, aff. क्विप्; the semivowel and following vowel of the radical changed to इ, and the final vowel of the noun made long.

m. (-कः)
An intelligent and penetrating man.
E.
मर्म्म a joint, and ठक् aff.: see मर्म्मविट्.

f. (-र्य्या)
A boundary, a limit.
ind.
Bounding, limitative.

f. (-दा)
1 Continuance in the right way, propriety of conduct, steadiness, rectitude.
2 A boundary, a limit.
3 A bank, a shore.
E.
मर्य्या limitative, आदा to have or take, aff. अङ् and टाप्; or परि about, round, prefixed to आदा, and म substituted for प.

r. 1st cl. (मर्वति)
1 To fill.
2 To go.

m. (-र्शः)
Counsel, advice.
E.
मृश to counsel, aff. घञ्.

m. (-र्षः)
Patience, endurance.
E.
मृष to bear with, aff. घञ्.

m. (-र्षः)
1 A venerable or respectable man, (in dramatic language.)
2 A potherb.
E.
मृष to suffer, aff. अण्; also मारिष.

n. (-णं)
Advising, counselling, deliberating.
E.
मृश to counsel, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
Enduring, bearing, patience, resignation.
E.
मृष to bear with, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Borne, endured.
2 Patient, content.
n. (-तं)
Patience.
E.
मृष to bear with, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान-वती-वत्)
Patient, enduring.
E.
मृष to bear, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Death, dying.
2 Killing, slaying, destroying.
3 Obstruction, opposition, impediment.
4 Thorn-apple, (Datura metel.)
5 A name of KĀMA.
f. (-री)
1 A name of CAṆḌĪ, a form of

DURGĀ.
2

Plague, pestilence, epidemic.
E.
मृ to die, aff. घञ्, or in the causal form, with अच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A cat.

m. (-जित्)
A BUDDHA.
E.
मार love, and जित् who overcomes.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Murderous.
E.
मार, and आत्मक्र disposed to.

Killing.
2

Ruin.
3

Plague, epidemic.
E.
मृ to die, causal form, इ aff.: see मार and मारी.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Killed, slain.
E.
मृ to die, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-कः)
The name of a royal saint.
E.
मारि plague, व्यसन calamity, वारक stopping.

m. (-षः)
A venerable person, (in dramatic language,) especially the title of the manager, or principal actor.
mf. (-षः-षी)
A potherb, (Amaranthus oleraceus.)
f. (-षी)
The mother of the sage DAKṢA.
E.
मृष to bear patiently, deriv. irr.

n. (-तं)
One of the duties of a king, his universal presence by means of his emissaries.
E.
मारुत the wind, and व्रत observance, pervading all things like the wind.

m. (-जः)
HANUMĀN, the monkey god.
E.
मारुत air, and आत्मज son.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Removing or opposing wind, windy humour, &c.
m. (-हः)
A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.)
E.
मारुत wind, or a disease of that humour, and अपह removing, obviating.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fasting, feeding on air.
E.
मारुत the wind, and अशन who eats.

m. (-तिः)
1 A name of

HANUMĀN.
2

The Pāṇḍava prince BHĪMA.
E.
मरुत wind, the deity, and इञ् patronymic aff.; the son of the wind.

f. (-का)
A small black ant.

m. (-ण्डः)
A Muni, and narrator of one of the Purāṇas.
E.
मृकण्डु the father of the saint, and अण् aff.

m. (-यः)
MĀRKAṆḌEYA a holy sage, the supposed author or narrator of one of the Purāṇas, named the Mārkaṇḍeya Purāṇa.
E.
मृकण्डु the father of the sage, and ढक् aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (मार्गति मार्गयति)
1 To make or prepare.
2 To go.
3 To prepare the way, to make a road.
4 To feather an arrow.
(मार्गयति-ते)
To seek.

m. (-र्गः)
1 A road, a path or way.
2 Search, seeking, inquiry.
3 The anus.
4

Musk.
5

The month in which the moon is full in the asterism Mṛgaśīrṣa, (November-December.)
6 The constellation Mṛgaśīrṣa.
7 (In geometry,) A section.
E.
मृग to inquire, aff. घञ्, or मृग a deer, aff. अण्.

m. (-कः)
The month Agrahāyaṇa, (November-December.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Mendicant, asking, begging, a beggar.
n. (-णं)
1 Asking, soliciting, begging.
2 Research, inquiry.
3 Affection, affectionate solicitation or inquiry.
m. (-णः)
1 An arrow.
2 A suppliant, a solicitor.
E.
मृग to ask, to seek, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
A suppliant, a beggar.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-नुः)
A Yojana, a measure of distance equal to 4,000 fathoms or four Kös, above eight miles.
E.
मार्ग a road, and धेनु a milch cow; also with कन् added, मार्गधेनुक (-कं).

m. (-वः)
A man of a low caste, born of a Niṣāda by an Ayogava female.

m. (-रः)
The month Agrahāyaṇa, (November-December.)
E.
मृगशिरस् the asterism in which the moon is full, and अण् aff.: also from मृगशीर्ष with अण् aff. मार्गशीर्ष.

m. (-र्षः)
The month Mārgaśīrṣa: see the last.

m. (-कः)
1 A deer-killer, a hunter.
2 A traveller, a wayfarer.
E.
मृग a deer, or मार्ग a road, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sought, inquired after, pursued.
E.
मृग to seek for, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्ग्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं)
1 To be cleaned or purified.
2 To be sought.
E.
मृज to cleanse, aff. ण्यत्, or मार्ग to seek, यत् aff.

r. 1st cl. (मार्जयति)
1 To sound.
2 To cleanse.

m. (-र्जः).
1 Cleaning the body.
2 A washerman.
3 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
मृज to cleanse, aff. घञ्.

nf. (-नं-नी)
1 Cleaning, cleansing, wiping.
2 Cleaning the person, by wiping, bathing, or rubbing it with oil or fragrant unguents.
m. (-नः)
A tree, commonly Lodh.
f. (-ना)
The sound of a drum.
f. (-नी)
1 A brush, a broom.
2 One of DURGĀ'S attendants.
E.
मृज to clean, aff. युच् or ल्युट्, or मार्ज to sound, with the same aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be cleaned, to be cleansed or purified.
E.
मृज to cleanse, अनीयर् aff.

mf. (-रः-री)
1 The common cat.
2 The wild or polecat.
E.
मृज to cleanse, (its skin and face,) आरन् aff., and the vowel made long.

m. (-कः)
A peacock.
E.
मार्जार a cat, and कन् aff.

m. (-ण्ठः)
A peacock, perhaps a wrong reading for the last, or vice versa.

f. (-का)
A goddess, a form of DURGĀ.
E.
मार्जार a cat, कर्ण the ear, कन् aff. fem. form; also मार्जारकर्णी having the ears of a cat.

f. (-का)
A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
E.
मार्जार a cat, गन्ध smell, कन् aff. of comparison; also मार्जारगन्धा.

m. (-लः)
A cat.
E.
see मार्जार, the final being changed to ल.

m. (-यः)
1 A cat.
2 A Śūdra.
2 Cleaning the body.
E.
मृज to clean, and आलीयच् Uṇādi aff.; it is also written मार्जारीय, from the र and ल being interchanged, or as derived from मार्जार, with छ aff.

Cleansed.
2

Adorned.
E.
मार्ज to clean, क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
